0022600040.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-4, 2nd in the Pacific and 7th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) in their 13th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup. The Warriors enter on a one-game losing streak after going 8-2 over their last ten, and they are missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Stephen Curry is day-to-day with abdominal soreness and a game-time decision. San Antonio is on a 10-game winning streak, going 10-0 over its last ten and 6-0 on the road, and is without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have yet to meet in the 2026-27 season, having split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a regular-season game in San Francisco on April 1, which the Warriors lost 127-113.
